svg.title: Toolmaker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as toolmaker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A C-frame micrometer has an upper anvil, lower spindle and thimble, with a narrow part in the measuring gap. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
